_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes: Relaunches the newly installed Smart Cuff after automatic Setup, aligns one attached Due before the GUI opens, and installs the new transparent product icon. No Due still opens offline; ambiguous or failed firmware alignment stops safely. This release is intentionally unsigned: for the official GitHub installer, select More info, verify SmartCuff_Setup.exe, then select Run anyway. Control behavior and firmware remain unchanged at rev27v-gauge-27.
